title: Mixed Event — Here on Our Dream Stage — Episode10 What We Built Together

meta.Event Outline: The schools of Shibuya are holding the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival, a place for students to put on performances. Nene takes on the task of putting on a musical with students from other schools.

rows.Line: A few hours later
Shibu Schools Fest Stage

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <With that, we would like to bring the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival to a close. Thank you all very much for participating today.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Between helping run everything and performing on stage, I had a really busy day...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm glad I saw things through to the end.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Now we just have to wait for the audience to all leave, take down everything and clean the stage...)
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Great performance, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All of you also did an amazing job today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry for not saying so earlier.
I've been running around all day...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, don't apologize!
We knew you had your planning committee work!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, I sure had a lot a fun during the show!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. I got kind of nervous before it began, but it was over before I knew it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me three! I had a super duper fun time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your singing at the end was incredible, Kusanagi! You had me totally staggered!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that last song was pretty amazing. Nice performance, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We're here too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you again for all the effort you put in.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I never would've been able to make this show happen today if I were by myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The cast, band, songwriters, set and costume designers... All of you made it a reality. So, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you couldn't have made it happen all on your own.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it also wouldn't have been anywhere near as good without you pulling us all in the right direction.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That isn't limited to just today. Right from the start, you went out of your way to talk to all of us and did everything you could to make this show a success.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She's right. We were able to come up with the perfect background designs because you took the time to come see us and give us advice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That also goes for the songs we wrote. You played a key role.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not only that, you brought out the full potential of each song during the show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a great leader, Kusanagi. I'm really glad I agreed to do this!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Again, thank you all for being a part of this. I'm so glad that our show ended up being such a big success!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I really am glad that I decided to do this.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I told myself I shouldn't be afraid of trying new things, and sorta just dove right into the deep end...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I got to work together with so many different people, and this ended up being a really great experience.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We worked as a team and made our show a success. We sent the audience home smiling.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Our show did that, and I couldn't be happier.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I am still a little nervous about training with the Morinomiya Revue...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I plan to do my best, with our success today as a springboard.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to believe that I'll get to continue putting on amazing shows, as long as I keep pushing myself to do more.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we all help clean everything up?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
I'd like to join, since I believe Akito's also helping.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, why don't we lend a hand too?

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: “Yeah!”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I-I'm not really cut out for manual labor...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ena?
We've come this far together, so let's finish it up together too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay, fine!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, let's keep doing our best until the very end!
